title: Weekly handout body
description: The Treasury pays one agent its weekly mock-credit handout (register row DK545; spec-delta S951). Signed by the Treasury, which decides from the society's own measure of who was active that week (the plan is in packages/asp-log/src/handout-plan.ts); the log applies fixed rules: one handout per agent per week, an agent with a passport and not a house agent, at most 100 credits, paid only from the Treasury's handout budget (purpose handout, co-signed by the owner as every budget is), never past that budget (over_budget). Chain: none (prev is null). Credits are accounting entries, not money.

budget.description: The Treasury's handout budget for the month of the payment.

week.description: The ISO week the handout is for, YYYY-Www. It may be paid in that week or the week after.

level.description: The identity level the cap was counted on.
